correctness.rationale: For labeled C_n, n>=3, inspected the bilateral strictly profitable exchange criterion for both adjacent and nonadjacent differently colored agents. Nonadjacent benefit iff their two original same-neighbor counts sum to <2; the adjacent case requires neighboring singleton runs. Hence stable iff J<=2 or all cyclic monochromatic runs have length >=2. Counting r alternating run compositions gives N_{n;a,b}=n+sum_{r>=2} (n/r) binom(a-r-1,r-1)binom(b-r-1,r-1), with the all-one-color cases separately 1. The pair-state transfer matrix excludes singleton runs, and 2n z^2 restores stable two-run configurations with a singleton. Its eigenvalues give Z_n(1)=phi^n+(1-phi)^n+2cos(n*pi/3)+2n. Analytic perturbation of the simple Perron eigenvalue lambda_+(z)=(1+sqrt(1+4z))/2 proves W/n->(5+sqrt5)/10 and centered sqrt(n) CLT variance sqrt5/25 for the UNRESTRICTED uniform stable coloring. This is an infinite proof, not inferred from finite checks.
